description: Addresses KEPServerEX refuses, with the reason category (syntax, range, unsupported).

vectors.description: (empty) on CJ1: empty
D on CJ1: no number
D-1 on CJ1: negative
D32768 on CJ1: past the end of DM
D32767 as float32 on CJ1: a 32-bit value needs D32767 and D32768
CIO6144 on CJ1: past the end of CIO
W512 on CJ1: past the end of WR
H1536 on CJ1: past the end of HR
A960 on CJ1: past the end of AR on CS1/CJ1
A10000 on CJ1: A10000-A11535 exist on CJ2 only
A1472 on CJ2: gap between A1471 and A10000
T4096 on CJ1: past the last timer
C4096 on CJ1: past the last counter
TK32 on CJ1: TK00-TK31 on CS1/CJ1
IR16 on CJ1: IR00-IR15
IR00 as uint16 on CJ1: index registers are 32-bit only
DR16 on CJ1: DR00-DR15
DR15 as int32 on CJ1: a 32-bit value needs DR15 and DR16
E00:32768 on CJ1: past the end of an EM bank
E13:0 on CJ1: EM banks 0-12 on CS1/CJ1
E25:0 on CJ2: EM banks 0-24 on CJ2
E0_100 on CJ1: Omron's W342 notation, not KEPServerEX syntax (E00:00100)
EM100 on CJ1: not KEPServerEX syntax (the current bank is E00100)
D100.16 on CJ1: bit above 15
D100. on CJ1: bit missing
D1.2.3 on CJ1: two bit numbers
X100 on CJ1: unknown area
DM100 on CJ1: not KEPServerEX syntax for DM
TS1.02 on CJ1: a completion flag has no bit
T1.02 on CJ1: timer present values have no bits
D100.000H on CJ1: string of length 0
D100.009L on CJ1: two-per-word strings have an even length
D100.514H on CJ1: two-per-word strings are at most 512 characters
D100.257D on CJ1: one-per-word strings are at most 256 characters
D32767.004H on CJ1: string runs past the end of DM
D100[0] on CJ1: zero array dimension
D100.05[2] on CJ1: Boolean arrays are not supported
D100[1][2][3] on CJ1: three dimensions
D32767[2] on CJ1: array runs past the end of DM
T0D on CJ1: 'D' suffix not allowed where the default type is BCD
D0D as float32 on CJ1: 'D' suffix not allowed on Float
D0D as bcd16 on CJ1: 'D' suffix not allowed on a BCD tag
D100 as bool on CJ1: Boolean needs a bit address
